substeps.label: 3b.1
substeps.caption: Container on with two people: one lifts it into place under the cone while the other closes the flange clamp. Finger-tight only.

substeps.label: 3b.2
substeps.caption: Through the door: catch bowl on the chamber floor and the splash plate above the container (one is enough for aluminium). Wipe the plate; hang the covers over the openings.

substeps.label: 3b.3
substeps.caption: Run the frequency check now, before closing. Then swing the door shut: the ultrasonic unit rides in it.

substeps.label: 3b.4
substeps.caption: Close all three clamps. Opening one under pressure just leaks.
